company_name: Tohoku University, Center for Innovative Integrated Electronic Systems
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The center contributes to semiconductor research and development, particularly in advanced technologies like spintronics and GaN on Si for power electronics.
summary: Tohoku University's Center for Innovative Integrated Electronic Systems is a research institution focusing on advanced semiconductor technologies. They work on developing hybrid CMOS/spintronics devices, brain-type non-volatile integrated circuits, and GaN on Si technology for power electronics, supporting the semiconductor value chain through innovation in integrated electronic systems.
capabilities: GaN on Si technology for power electronics
